links.outcome: Agreement of LLM screening versus MANAGE-PD with specialist decisions for device-aided therapy eligibility
links.effect: Kappa about 0.575 (LLM) vs 0.567 (MANAGE-PD); no significant difference in kappa (p = 0.81) or discordant classifications (McNemar p = 1.0).
links.quote: Agreement with specialist decisions was similar for LLM-based screening and MANAGE-PD (κ ≈ 0.575 vs. 0.567), with no significant differences in Cohen's kappa (p = 0.81) or discordant classifications (McNemar p = 1.0).

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the screening diagnostic accuracy of several commercial LLMs compared to specialist judgment and an established clinical screening tool for Parkinson's disease device-aided therapy referral, without evaluating specific deployment safeguards or practices.
